title: A new resolution space for nonlinear Schrödinger equations and applications
summary: Resolution spaces play a central role in constructing solutions for nonlinear partial differential equations. One of the main goals in the area of nonlinear dispersive PDEs has been to construct effective resolution spaces which capture the known bilinear restrictions estimates for free solutions. In this paper we propose a new structure for the Schrödinger equation which effectively replicates the classical bilinear $L^2_{t,x}$ estimate.
